citation.authors: Radin RG, Palmer JR, Rosenberg L, Kumanyika SK et al

record.population: 21,861 premenopausal Black women in the Black Women's Health Study, followed 1997-2007
record.finding: During 162,604 person-years, 5,800 fibroid cases were diagnosed. Dietary glycaemic index was weakly associated with fibroid risk overall (highest against lowest quintile 1.09, 95% CI 0.99-1.19; P for trend 0.04), with stronger links in women under 35 for glycaemic load (1.18) and in college-educated women for glycaemic index (1.17).
record.note: Questionnaire diet; the authors call the findings something that warrants further study.
